title: Connect and complete KDE KCM flows on the system bus

namtor_kcm.cpp: Changed QDBusConnection::sessionBus() to QDBusConnection::systemBus() at all 3 D-Bus sites (v1 iface creation, v2 iface creation, signal connect)
Added v2 QDBusInterface for org.namtor.Manager2 on system bus
Added WirePamServiceInfo (ssbss) and WireProtectionStatus (sbs) D-Bus wire structs + QDBusArgument operators + metatype registration
Added Q_INVOKABLE listPamServices(), setPamServiceEnabled(serviceId, enabled), getProtectionStatus()
Added Q_INVOKABLE refresh() (calls listProfiles + getStatus + listPamServices + getProtectionStatus)
Added v2 signal handlers: onPamServicesChangedDBus, onProtectionStatusChangedDBus
Added v2 reply handlers: handleListPamServicesReply, handleSetPamServiceEnabledReply, handleGetProtectionStatusReply
Preserved generation-based stale-response sequencing for all v1 and v2 async calls
namtor_kcm.h: Added Q_PROPERTY: protectionSealing, protectionHasTpm, protectionWarning, pamServices
Added Q_INVOKABLE: listPamServices, setPamServiceEnabled, getProtectionStatus, refresh
Added members: m_iface2, m_protectionSealing, m_protectionHasTpm, m_protectionWarning, m_pamServices
main.qml: Full rewrite to eliminate bridge/QML drift
Uses Namtor.NamtorKcm QML_SINGLETON directly (no property var bridge)
Every control calls a real NamtorKcm Q_INVOKABLE method or binds a real Q_PROPERTY
Enrollment flow: start (startEnrollment) -> progress (coveragePercent/qualityLabel/framesCaptured) -> review (reviewProfile) -> commit/cancel (commitProfile/cancelEnrollment)
Profile actions: list (profileList model), enable/disable (enableProfile), rename (renameProfile), replace (replaceProfile atomic), delete (deleteProfile)
Protection status display: protectionSealing, protectionHasTpm, protectionWarning
PAM services property wired (pamServices) for Task 16 UI controls

External signal refresh: ProfileChanged triggers listProfiles (bridge), StatusChanged updates status (bridge), PamServicesChanged updates pamServices (bridge), ProtectionStatusChanged updates protection status (bridge)
No recursive open: KCM does not open another instance of itself
No biometric data in UI (metadata, quality buckets, coverage %, protection status only)
Accessibility: all controls keyboard-reachable, Accessible.name/description, i18n()
changes.profile_model.h: No changes needed — profile model is bus-agnostic, fed by bridge
changes.CMakeLists.txt: No changes needed — no new source files

flows_verified.enrollment_start_progress_review_commit: startEnrollment(uid,name) -> EnrollmentProgress signals update coveragePercent/qualityLabel/framesCaptured -> reviewProfile(uid,session) -> reviewReady signal updates reviewQuality/reviewNeedsReenroll -> commitProfile(session) -> enrollmentCompleted + listProfiles refresh
flows_verified.enrollment_cancel: cancelEnrollment(session) bumps generation, clears state, discards stale replies
flows_verified.profile_list: listProfiles() async call, generation-guarded reply updates NamtorProfileModel
flows_verified.profile_replace_atomic: replaceProfile(uid,id,name) is a single daemon-side atomic call; handleVoidReply refreshes list. QML confirms before calling. Replace either fully succeeds or fully fails on the daemon side.
flows_verified.pam_services_list: listPamServices() v2 async -> handleListPamServicesReply updates pamServices QVariantList
flows_verified.pam_service_toggle: setPamServiceEnabled(serviceId,enabled) v2 async -> handleSetPamServiceEnabledReply -> listPamServices refresh (polkit-gated on daemon side)

build_verification.cmake_build: pass — libnamtorqml.so + namtor-abi-smoke built, 0 warnings, 0 errors
build_verification.qml_aot_compile: pass — main_qml.cpp QML cache compiled without warnings

drift_elimination.new_qml_uses: Namtor.NamtorKcm singleton with real Q_INVOKABLE methods and Q_PROPERTY bindings
